login.title: Sign in
login.description: Sign in to manage your automations.

mfa.title: Two-step verification
mfa.description: Enter the six-digit code from your authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes.

signup.title: Create your account
signup.setupDescription: This is the first account on this installation. It becomes the owner of the first workspace.
signup.description: Create an account to start automating your conversations.
signup.invitedDescription: You were invited to join {workspace}. Create your account with {email}.
signup.name: Your name
signup.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. A short sentence is easier to remember than symbols.
signup.closedDescription: Ask a workspace admin on this installation to invite you.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.description: Enter your account's email. If it exists, we will send a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sentDescription: If an account exists for {email}, a reset link is on its way. It expires in 1 hour.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.description: Pick a new password. Every device signed in to your account will be signed out.
reset.doneDescription: Sign in with your new password.
reset.missingToken: This reset link is incomplete. Ask for a new one.

invite.title: Join {workspace}
invite.description: You were invited to join {workspace} as {role}.
invite.invalidDescription: It may have expired, been revoked or already been accepted. Ask for a new one.
